Solara — (9.8) SOLSTICE

TERRITORIAL FIELD

"Territorial field, nobody's land"

[Verse 1]

Level negative twenty-two

Nobody’s land, nobody’s map

We walk where no one owns

Toward the place she lost herself

Aldric had a map out

(he pulled it from somewhere)

(he always had a map)

(this one did not have this part)

[Spoken]

[Solara:] How far to forty-five

[Aldric:] The map does not know. I have another map. The other map also does not know

[Pre-Chorus]

The plan was negative forty-five

Reach Sigma from there

The last time she was there she lost her memory

But Aldric’s map was glowing

(the old kind, not fire)

And Void had said, if answers are anywhere, they are there

[Chorus]

Territorial field, nobody’s land

Territorial field, the unmapped below

We walk where no one owns

Toward the star that knows

Three of them and a map that glows

And a plan that ends at forty-five

[Verse 2]

[Spoken]

[Solara:] Aldric. What happened to me there

[Aldric:] You forgot. Enough that you came back different

[Solara:] Different how

[Aldric:] Quieter

(She already knew)

Then a watcher

(neutral observers)

(writing everything down)

(it is not personal)

[Watcher:] The council is gone

(the watcher wrote this down)

[Watcher:] No one can reach them. They went when your trap was sprung

[Watcher:] I am writing this down

[Watcher:] The army from Level two-ninety is moving down

[Watcher:] To the one hundred

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Below one hundred is the light’s

Above is the dark’s

That was the pact

If they cross the line, they take the rest

The watcher wrote this down too

(it is not personal)

(but the count is climbing)

[Chorus 2]

Territorial field, nobody’s land

Territorial field, the unmapped below

We walk where no one owns

Toward the star that knows

Three of them and a map that glows

And a plan that ends at forty-five

[Bridge]

The council’s army still fights at the line

But no one is directing them anymore

[Watcher:] They do not know to stop. So they do not stop

[Watcher:] They also do not know where to go

[Watcher:] I am writing this down

[Solara:] How long

[Watcher:] Soon

[Void:] That is not a number

[Watcher:] I know. I will write down soon. It is not a number. I will write down the number also when it arrives

[Final Chorus - key lift]

Territorial field, nobody’s land

Territorial field, but not for long

The line at one hundred is the pact

And the pact is walking down

The council’s gone, the army fights alone

Heading to forty-five, heading to the star

[Outro]

[Solara:] Aldric. The map

[Aldric:] The glowing one is for negative forty-five

[Void:] Negative forty-five

[Solara:] Negative forty-five

They walked

The watcher watched them go

(then wrote this down)

(it was not personal)

Level negative forty five.

Where answers might be when we arrive

Level negative forty five

Level negative forty five
